title: Vestil Low-Profile Steel Drum Dolly with Steering Handle & Poly Wheels (1,200 lb Capacity) - Yellow
description: Reduce injuries caused by manually lifting and moving drums. Transport drums or pails with the low-profile drum caddy. To use: align unit in front of drum, remove handle, and grip drum with the handle. Tip drum up while guiding the caddy base under the drum. Re-attach handle and transport drum to desired location. Caddy rolls easily on casters. The removable handle doubles as a bung nut wrench and seal remover.

specifications.For Use With: (1) 55 gallon drum; (1) 30 gallon drum; (2) 5 gallon pails
specifications.Includes: (1) Steel Low Profile Drum Dolly with Poly On Steel Casters
specifications.Application: Reduce injuries caused by manually lifting and moving drums.
specifications.Features: High strength steel construction offers long lasting rugged use. Removable pivoting handle can be used as a drum tool. Beveled front edge makes loading drum simple. Additional platform supports can handle smaller diameter drums
